scan_notes.description: Working notes: what you read, what you checked, what you deliberately ruled out. Written before any finding is committed to.

title.description: One line, under 80 characters, stating the defect itself.

severity.description: critical = data loss, security breach, or corruption reachable in production. high = wrong behaviour on a realistic input. medium = a real defect on an edge case. low = degrades maintainability with no behavioural bug.

file.description: Repository-relative path. Use the plan/document path when reviewing a plan.

evidence.description: What in the code or document establishes this. Quote the operative line rather than describing it.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, leading to a concrete wrong outcome. If no such scenario can be written, the finding does not belong in this list.

suggested_fix.description: The smallest change that removes the defect.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Reflects how certain you are the defect is real, not how severe it would be.

overall_verdict.description: 'not sound' requires at least one critical or high finding.
